title: Path to Mastery
vision: An ever-loyal, local-first personal assistant that uses private models, approved knowledge and local tools first, then asks permission before using allowlisted web or external services.

core.name: Rangabot
core.subtitle: Loyal local personal assistant
core.description: The central intelligence connecting conversation, planning, knowledge, memory, tools, creation and trust.
unlockCriteria: Every mastery path has at least one dependable end-to-end capability
Local-first permission boundaries pass security review
Core quality and latency targets remain green for two releases

branches.name: Mind & Memory
branches.summary: Understand intent, plan work and learn locally without hidden model mutation.

nodes.name: Natural conversation
nodes.description: Stream private local-model conversations with stop control and structured history.
nodes.backlog: Maintain reliability across supported local models

nodes.name: Intent planning
nodes.description: Classify requests and plan retrieval or artifact work using bounded context.
acceptance: Separate retrieval, creation and tool intents

nodes.name: Inspectable local memory
nodes.description: Remember preferences, proficiency, corrections and approved conclusions with provenance.
acceptance: Every memory has origin and confidence
Users can inspect, edit, export and delete
No conversation silently becomes universal fact
nodes.backlog: Design the local memory schema and review UI

nodes.name: Learning progress
nodes.description: Track what the user understands and adapt explanations without profiling invisibly.
acceptance: User can reset a subject profile

nodes.name: Self-review loop
nodes.description: Review grounding, completeness and contradictions before returning important work.
acceptance: Revision never replaces a stronger draft
nodes.backlog: Replace lexical checks with stronger entailment review

branches.name: Scholar
branches.summary: Turn private books and approved research into clear, cited teaching.

nodes.name: Knowledge Vault
nodes.description: Incrementally ingest supported local documents with hierarchy, embeddings and rollback.
nodes.backlog: Improve OCR guidance and extraction coverage

nodes.name: Hybrid retrieval
nodes.description: Combine keyword and vector search while guarding relevance and subject boundaries.

nodes.name: Reliable Teacher
nodes.description: Synthesize original explanations from several books and labelled model background.
nodes.backlog: Fix mythology variance, synthesis and latency

nodes.name: Cross-book concepts
nodes.description: Maintain rebuildable concepts, relationships, agreements and disagreements across sources.

nodes.name: Current awareness
nodes.description: Maintain meaningful weekly and monthly offline intelligence with evidence classes.
nodes.backlog: Broaden sources and automate freshness validation

branches.name: Analyst
branches.summary: Execute Python, SQL and models locally, then explain results without inventing data.

nodes.name: Analytics knowledge
nodes.description: Teach Python, SQL, statistics, ML, visualization and data platforms from local sources.

nodes.name: Safe local runtime
nodes.description: Run approved Python and SQL in a bounded local sandbox with visible inputs and outputs.
nodes.backlog: Choose the first Python and SQL sandbox design

nodes.name: Evidence-backed analysis
nodes.description: Base conclusions on actual executed queries, checks and model results.
acceptance: Every finding links to executed evidence

nodes.name: Local model lab
nodes.description: Train or evaluate approved local models and interpret reproducible results.

nodes.name: Analytical reports
nodes.description: Create decision-ready reports with validated charts, tables, caveats and sources.
nodes.backlog: Unlock after execution and artifact quality

branches.name: Builder
branches.summary: Understand, change, test and document approved local software projects.

nodes.name: Repository context
nodes.description: Allowlist repositories and attach bounded, revalidated code previews.
nodes.backlog: Improve file selection and preview UX

nodes.name: Code understanding
nodes.description: Explain selected code and answer scoped project questions using the local model.

nodes.name: Coding agent
nodes.description: Plan, edit, run and verify code inside an explicitly approved project.

nodes.name: Technical documentation
nodes.description: Create repository-grounded documentation, architecture summaries and diagrams.

nodes.name: Project delivery
nodes.description: Coordinate specifications, implementation, verification and release notes locally.

branches.name: Creator
branches.summary: Create polished documents, writing, slides and spreadsheets through normal chat.

nodes.name: Word creation
nodes.description: Gather a brief in chat and create a validated DOCX with local previews.

nodes.name: Word editing
nodes.description: Safely revise a user-selected document while preserving unaffected content and layout.
nodes.backlog: Implement the next artifact vertical slice

nodes.name: Email & writing studio
nodes.description: Draft, revise and critique audience-aware email and long-form writing locally.

nodes.name: PDF & presentations
nodes.description: Create printable PDFs and story-led presentation decks with visual QA.

nodes.name: Spreadsheets
nodes.description: Create validated XLSX workbooks with formulas, charts and explanations.

branches.name: Personal Assistant
branches.summary: Help with files, research, email, calendar and routines under explicit permissions.

nodes.name: Local projects
nodes.description: Organize chats into local project folders without granting filesystem access.

nodes.name: Web allowlist
nodes.description: Let users persistently approve, inspect and revoke trusted web domains locally.
nodes.backlog: Implement permission storage and review UI

nodes.name: Permissioned web research
nodes.description: Search allowlisted sources only when local knowledge is insufficient, with citations and dates.

nodes.name: Email & calendar
nodes.description: Read and prepare personal workflows while requiring confirmation before mutations.
acceptance: Send and calendar changes always confirmed

nodes.name: Daily companion
nodes.description: Prepare local briefs, reminders and proactive suggestions without becoming intrusive.

branches.name: Guardian
branches.summary: Keep permissions, evidence, execution and external handoffs safe and inspectable.

nodes.name: Local-first boundary
nodes.description: Bind locally and reject remote model endpoints unless a future consent system exists.
nodes.backlog: Keep the boundary covered as tools expand

nodes.name: Permission centre
nodes.description: Show and revoke every repository, web, file, connector and execution permission.
nodes.backlog: Generalize repository approval into capability permissions

nodes.name: Evidence provenance
nodes.description: Distinguish vault evidence, model background, executed results and web sources.

nodes.name: Quality evaluation
nodes.description: Measure retrieval, answers, grounding, regressions and latency using local fixtures.

nodes.name: Local authentication
nodes.description: Prevent other local processes from freely invoking sensitive Rangabot APIs.
acceptance: Network binding remains disabled until complete

branches.name: Companion
branches.summary: Make private intelligence calm, beautiful, accessible and easy to understand.

nodes.name: Chat experience
nodes.description: Responsive chat, themes, Markdown, replies, thinking states and scroll control.
nodes.backlog: Run broader accessibility and device testing

nodes.name: Ranga personality
nodes.description: A restrained golden-retriever identity with helpful, non-intrusive personality.

nodes.name: Path to Mastery
nodes.description: A public evidence-backed skill tree that doubles as the contributor backlog.
acceptance: Every node has dependencies and acceptance criteria

nodes.name: Skill discovery
nodes.description: Help users understand what Rangabot can do now and which abilities are still training.
acceptance: Suggested tasks never advertise locked skills

nodes.name: Community growth
nodes.description: Let contributors claim well-scoped nodes with public acceptance criteria and evidence.
acceptance: Every claim maps to an issue
